header.case_description: WECC240, 60 Hz three-phase EMT. 243 AC buses, 325 line and series-capacitor branches, 122 transformers, 103 synchronous machines and 37 grid-following plants.
header.case_comments: 100 MVA base. Uncoupled phases use the source positive-sequence R, X and B. Nine series capacitors retain their charge states. Transformers assume 0.001 pu no-load current and 20 kW core loss. Adelanto and Sylmar imports match signed admittance at 60 Hz with an assumed 20 Hz bandwidth. Inverters use the Hawaii LCL filter, DC supply and smoothed PWM, with current-loop gains set by Tg. Plant 5032_W uses its initial reactive output as its upper limit. The three-phase fault at John Day bus 4005 uses a 0.01 pu reactor and a switched discharge resistor.
